exhibitor_photos_caption_check.name: exhibitor_photos_caption_check
exhibitor_photos_caption_check.value: "exhibitor_photos"."caption" IS NULL OR char_length("exhibitor_photos"."caption") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

exhibitor_photos_duration_check.name: exhibitor_photos_duration_check
exhibitor_photos_duration_check.value:
